summary: Dependency-audit + regression testing after modal sticky-footer refactor. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass covering new /api/_diag/health, /api/_diag/seed (admin idempotent + 401), PATCH /api/character (auth + partial + 400-on-only-unknowns), PUT /api/character now admin-gated, plus regression smoke on 9 public/admin endpoints. Frontend: verified sticky-footer at 1100x600 viewport for all 6 modals (ProfileEditModal, DesignElementModal, BrandAssetModal, LicenseModal, FanArt SubmitModal, LinkModal) — every primary save/create button is visible in the viewport without scrolling. All 9 routes (/home /dashboard /design /gallery /links /fanart /brand /credits /merch) load 200 with zero page errors. Dependency audit: pip check + yarn integrity clean per main-agent context; runtime confirms no import failures.

minor.issue: Spec says 'rejects unknown fields with 400', but implementation silently drops unknown fields when at least one allowed field is present (only returns 400 when payload contains ZERO allowed fields). Non-blocking; behaviour is safe (whitelisting), but does not match spec wording.

issues: Uses native browser date picker (input type='date' showing mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar component. Minor consistency issue only.
Shows only 'OFF/ON' label with no title such as 'Admin mode' — carried over from iter 2, still unfixed.

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether PATCH /api/character should return 400 when payload contains any unknown key (strict) or silently ignore (current, permissive). Update spec or code accordingly.
(Optional/minor) Consider replacing native date input in LicenseModal with shadcn Calendar for design consistency.
(Optional/minor) verify_token still uses bare `except:` (server.py line 121) — should catch jwt.PyJWTError; carried over from iter 1+2.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown large (~1140 lines) and mixes auth, design, fanart, links, merch, commissions, credits, uploads, storage — recommend splitting into routers/*.py modules before further growth.
PATCH /api/character docstring says 'Only allowed fields are applied' but spec asks for hard-rejection on unknowns. Either enforce or update docs.
/api/_diag/seed replaces the entire character doc when ?force=true — dangerous for prod; consider requiring an explicit confirmation string param.
/api/_diag/health leaks env-var presence (booleans) and collection counts — acceptable for staging, but consider gating behind an admin token in production.
verify_token bare `except:` (line 121) — should be `except jwt.PyJWTError` (carried from iter 1).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on sticky-footer regression across 6 modals + 9-route load smoke

test_credentials: Debut/Admin password: 'veri2024' → POST /api/auth/verify-debut → JWT (24h). localStorage key: 'veri_admin_token'.
seed_data_creation: No TEST_-prefixed data left in DB. PATCH tests restored character fields to originals in same-test teardown. Verified via GET /api/character.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 3 focus was: (1) new diagnostic endpoints /api/_diag/health (public) + /api/_diag/seed (POST, admin, idempotent), (2) PATCH /api/character partial-update contract, (3) PUT /api/character now admin-gated, (4) sticky-footer on 6 modals at 1100x600. All green. Testids used for modal footer check: pf-save, elem-save, ba-save, lic-save, fanart-submit-btn, link-save. To trigger BrandLibrary Licenses tab use [data-testid=brand-tab-licenses] (NOT text=Licenses — the tab uses testid). To open DesignElementModal, click a [data-testid^=hotspot-] element on the canvas → then click [data-testid^=detail-edit-]. FanArt SubmitModal opens via [data-testid=open-submit-btn]. Note: initial page load can be slow (>15s to reach networkidle due to background image assets) — always prefer `wait_until=domcontentloaded` + explicit wait_for_timeout rather than networkidle. Backend spec mentions GET /api/_diag/seed but only POST is implemented — GET returns 405. Confirm with main agent whether that's intentional.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs. All spec items verified. Only two minor spec-vs-impl mismatches noted (PATCH unknown-field behaviour, GET /_diag/seed not implemented).
